name: random-ticks-stone-platform
comment: A standing player on a stone platform (id 1) with sand (12) and gravel (13) columns, glowstone (89), glass (20) and obsidian (49): no block here has a random-tick or randomDisplayTick override, so the trace pins the world side of a player: World.rand (randomDisplayUpdates, 6000 draws per tick; cave sounds), the random-tick LCG (80 per chunk in 19x19 chunks), joinEntityInSurroundings every 30 ticks, scheduled sand/gravel ticks, and a gravel block falling at t = 50. No entity_state: the player's own update (EntityPlayer, WP-2.5) is not transcribed.
